test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 11 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A and B are brothers, and their maternal uncles are C and D. E is D's wife and the sister-in-law of F. F is the only daughter of G. G is B's maternal grandmother. How is F related to A?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Given: 

1) A and B are brothers, and their maternal uncles are C and D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d2d163316e3196fef7152bfe175f9a62eb3b0904b8f79b1de6f481e9d794ef24.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/974a3af7def6cca6f0db92d551cf680baf02d8fcac5aa57453eaaf85c8b0175d.png] 

2) E is D's wife and the sister-in-law of F. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/572fa96247abff8f08bf2613922e06c75be0dfc0371b88348ad76ecaa4c26ebc.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f18aca15d00cd08b5bab1a8c7606b04827c2bde129625573911c1febccf6c87c.png] 

3) F is the only daughter of G.

4) G is B's maternal grandmother.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1c80c60fdb4ec2dc1f13631ade289d91a3b1002da821ea0bb7da4807541b6d84.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47fda1fed27c5be0ac89704d370a62ef51821649d17377c7364716a081bd17ea.png] 

So, F is A's mother.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
